trigger: Theo's foot is infected. Bring him to the hospital (or Marguerite's kitchen if no ames_deal).

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Theo's toes are dark at the tips. He hid it in two pairs of socks.

nodes.speaker: ames
nodes.text: Diabetic foot, early gangrene, two toes. He's been skipping. You didn't know. Next— no. Sit.

nodes.speaker: ames
nodes.text: I can take the toes and keep the foot. Your dam is why I have lights to do it.

nodes.speaker: ames
nodes.text: You kept your end. I keep mine. Lantus, two vials, monthly. While the lights stay on.

nodes.speaker: marguerite
nodes.text: Kitchen table, my dear. Boil everything. Hold his hand. Don't look at me, look at him.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: It takes an hour. Theo bites a belt. Marguerite hums the whole time. The foot stays.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: She does what she can with what you brought. It isn't enough. The foot goes below the ankle.

nodes.speaker: theo
nodes.text: so. eight toes. still more than a dog. ...thanks.

nodes.speaker: theo
nodes.text: hey. hey ma. it's okay. you can carry me now. finally a quest.
